title: Structs and fields mint IRIs from the base namespace; types map to BDDO (YAML surface)
description: Root and its fields become <base>Root and <base>Root.<field>; u16, i32le and f64 name the BDDO data types, ascii[4] a 4-byte string in ASCII, and the lone sibling in bytes[n] the bddo:sizeFromField form. The YAML mirror compiles to the same graph.
